payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results from previous studies comparing XLNet with other models like BERT and RoBERTa, particularly in the context of negation detection and scope resolution tasks.

claims.text: XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa in negation detection and scope resolution tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the BioScope Corpus and SFU Review Corpus.
On the negation scope resolution task, XLNet achieved an increase of 3.16 F1 points on the BioScope Full Papers and 0.3 F1 points on the SFU dataset.
Contrary to results on benchmark GLUE tasks, XLNet outperforms RoBERTa in the context of negation detection and scope resolution.
